translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Eranchcha na'ay bare aawuwaa seeraa sisee; shin k'iliic'iyaawe seeraa sisenna.
Asay bare doonaappe kesiyaa k'aalan lo"obaa akkee; shin ammanttennawanttu makkalabaa amottiino.
Bare doonaa naagiyaa uray bare shemppuwaa naagee; shin ellekka haasayiyaa uray barena d'ayissee.
Azallay amottee; shin ayaanne demmenna; shin minniide ootsiyaawanttu kallana.
S'illo asatuu wordduwaa haasayaa is's'iino. Shin iita asatuwaa haasayay yeellayeenne kawushshee.
Suure de'uwaa de'iyaa uraa Aa s'illotetsay naagee; shin nagaranchchaa Aa nagaray kunddisee.
Barena dure malatissiyaa Asay de'ee; shin aw ayaynne baawa; haray k'ay barena hiyyeesaa malatissiyaawe de'ee; shin aw daro duretay de'ee.
Asay bare shaluwaan bare shemppuwaa wozanaw danddayee; shin hiyyeesaa yashissiyaawe baawa.
S'illotuwaa s'omppii pooc'umi poo'ee; shin iitatuwaa s'omppii to'ana.
Otoruu walassaa yelee; shin zoriyaa akkiyaawanttu aad'd'eeda eranchcha.
Daaburi bayinnan demmeedda miishshay ellekka d'ayee; shin min ootsiide demmeedda duretay, dari dariide bee.
Koyiyaawe polettennaan gam"iyaawe kayyoyee; shin amotteeddawe polettiyaawe nashechchee.
Zoriyaa kad'iyaa uray metuwaan gelee; shin azazuwaa bonchchiyaa uray saruwaan de'ana.
Aad'd'eeda eranchchay immiyaa timirttii de'uwaa pultto; hewe Asay hayk'k'uwaa p'iriyaappe kessi akkanaw maaddee.
Akeekay de'iyaa uray bonchchetee; shin ammanettennan aggiyaawe bashshaw afee.
C'inc'c'a Asay ubbay eran ootsee; shin boozay bare boozatetsaa k'onc'c'issee.
Asay kiitteedda iita kiitanchchay, metuwaan geliino; shin ammantsiyaa asatuu kiitteeddawe, sarotetsaa ahiino.
Seeraa is's'iyaa Asay hiyyeeseenne yeellatee; shin seerina sisiyaa uray bonchchetee.
Amotteeddawaa demmiyaawe loytsi nashechchee; shin iitatuu iitaappe haakkanaw koyikkino.
Aad'd'eeda eranchcha asatuwaana hamettiyaa Asay aad'd'eeda eranchcha gidee; shin booza asatuwaana hamettiyaa Asay metuwaan gelee.
Nagaranchchatuwaa iita kaac'ay kaallee; shin s'illotuu lo"o oosuwaa woytuwaa akkana.
Lo"o Asay bare naanatuwaa naanatuwaa laatissee; shin nagaranchchaa duretay s'illoo dagattee.
Hiyyeesaa goshshay daro katsaa ayifanaw danddayee; shin suure pirdday pac'c'eeddawaa gaasuwaan d'ayee.
K'ayis'eeriyaan wad'd'anaw k'arettiyaa uray bare na'aa is's'ee; shin bare na'aa siik'iyaa uray minniide seeree.
S'illuu Aa uluu kallana gakkanaw mee; shin nagaranchchay koshattee.
